states.name: first_use_offline
states.requiredBehavior: Initial use requires internet access and successful authentication.

states.name: first_use_online_sign_in_success
states.requiredBehavior: Successful online authentication establishes the backend user session.

states.name: authenticated_session
states.requiredBehavior: User-owned backend state is accessible only through the authenticated session identity.

states.name: invalid_or_expired_session_online
states.requiredBehavior: Backend user sync state is unavailable until the client reauthenticates.

states.name: previously_authenticated_offline_reopen
states.requiredBehavior: The free core remains usable offline indefinitely after initial successful authentication.

states.name: cross_account_access_attempt
states.requiredBehavior: Backend authorization derives user identity from session credentials and rejects cross-user state access.
